newsitem.title: GREECE: NATIONAL MORTGAGE BANK/GREECE TO CUT RATES JUNE 17.
newsitem.headline: NATIONAL MORTGAGE BANK/GREECE TO CUT RATES JUNE 17.

text.p: State National Mortgage Bank of Greece will slash its three-year and six-year fixed rate mortgages by 50 and 175 basis points to 12 and 11.25 percent respectively from June 17, it said in a statement.
The bank will also cut its 10, 15 and 20-year adjustable rate mortgages by 50 basis points to 15.25 percent, it added.
Its Stegi-1 mortgage rates will be lowered to 11.4 percent from 11.75 percent, it said.
National Mortgage Bank will also reduce its consumer loan rates and its K-MasterCard rate by 100 basis points to 23.5 percent, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
